plan: 'Guide map of Chittaurgarh', Archaeological Survey of India, Jaipur Circle, 2010 (prepared by V.K. Uppal and Vivek Nigam, Surveyors Gr-I): a relief board at the site. Photograph by Amitbanerjee0143, Wikimedia Commons 'Chittorgarh Fort Map.jpg', 12 July 2015, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution required; share-alike). Catalogue: not a catalogued source (new).
pixel_frame: native 2560x1920 photograph; x right, y down. The board is photographed nearly head-on; a similarity fit left no visible skew (an affine fit improved rms only from 20 to 18 m).
method: similarity transform from board pixels to OSM local metres (x east, y north; origin = centroid of the OSM outline way 782250688). Control points are the centroids of 12 blue (tank) regions found by colour thresholding, matched by name and position to OSM tank polygons: Ratan Singh Tank, Kukreshwar Kund, Kumaria Talab, Bolia Talab, Tel Ki Bawri, Ghee Ki Baori, Gomukh Kund, Hathi Kund, Fatta Tank, Bhimlat Kund, Suraj Kund, Chatrang ka Talab.

fit.north: left on the board (the board's arrow points left)

validation_not_in_fit.feature: Ratan Singh's Palace (board white rectangle vs OSM building)
Vijaya Stambh symbol vs OSM 'Victory Tower'
Rana Kumbha's Palace (large footprint, centre read by eye)

added_from_board: plan-mrigvan-pond (tanks with no OSM water within 130-480 m of their centre)
not_traced: the board's other white and yellow footprints that OSM already maps, the lettering, the route lines, the Mrigvan forest hatching; gate positions (OSM nodes are used, the board only letters their names beside the road)
traced_by: colour thresholding for tanks (contours simplified at 3 px); the Kirti Stambh symbol and check points read by eye; pixel coordinates are in tools/trace/curation/chittorgarh.mjs
